question: What internal experience affects even the wise person at the tip of nectar?
premises: There is a tip of nectar
There is an essence of juice
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
uncertainties: The precise yogic referent of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa is technical.
plain_english: Even the wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
